Theme

Latin word

heri

heri (here)

adverb

yesterday

In this lexicon

  • yesterday

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 11.1.1: heri vesperī (Lewis & Short); Sen. Ep. 64.1: fuistī here nōbīscum; Traupman 89

  • heri vesperī: yesterday evening

    classical

  • heri māne: yesterday morning

    classical

Notes

  1. 1Write heri, not herī: the classical word has a short final vowel, shortened from an older herī. Ruling: heri with a short final i.

Examples

  • fuistī here nōbīscum

    you were with us yesterdaySen. Ep. 64.1

    In the entry for yesterday

  • ignis in hesternō stīpite parvus erat

    a small fire was still burning in yesterday’s logOv. Fast. 5.506

    In the entry for yesterday
